purpose: Incremental verified company-website review for studies missing adjudications in the 762-NCT census
scope: Official issuer announcements cross-linked by exact NCT, study code, drug and indication; not independently verified FDA approval or calibrated trading predictions.

records.specificEvidence: Week 44 clinical remission 25 mg 50.8% and 50 mg 51.3% vs placebo 10.4%; both p<0.0001. Primary endpoint met for both doses.
records.safetyEvidence: Company reports no new safety signal; complete adverse-event tables in release.
records.regulatory: Company intended NDA submission late Q4 2026; not proof of submission or FDA acceptance.
records.crosswalk: Official IR press release identifies ABTECT Maintenance Study 107; registry NCT05535946 sponsor ID ABX464-107

records.regulatory: Clinical trial endpoint evidence, not FDA approval.

records.regulatory: Issuer planned sNDA submission before end of 2026, not independently FDA verified.

records.specificEvidence: Sponsor reported both 6- and 12-week continuous abstinence primary comparisons met versus placebo: 25.3% vs 4.4%, and 32.6% vs 7.0%, respectively; both p<0.0001.
records.safetyEvidence: Sponsor reported no treatment-related serious adverse events. JAMA 2023 publication PMID 37432430 confirms trial NCT04576949 and reports 6- and 12-week endpoint effects.
records.regulatory: Achieve announced a June 22, 2026 FDA cytisinicline NDA Complete Response Letter citing third-party manufacturing and labeling, with no clinical efficacy or safety deficiencies identified. A regulatory CRL is not a Phase 3 endpoint failure.
records.crosswalk: JAMA 2023 trial publication PMID 37432430 explicitly identifies ORCA-2 as NCT04576949; official sponsor release identifies ORCA-2.

records.specificEvidence: Sponsor reported primary continuous smoking abstinence significantly higher than placebo: 14.8% vs 6.0% for 6-week treatment (p=0.0008), and 30.3% vs 9.4% for 12-week treatment (p<0.0001).
records.safetyEvidence: Sponsor reported no treatment-related serious adverse events. JAMA Internal Medicine 2025 trial publication PMID 40257755 independently reports both primary endpoint comparisons.
records.regulatory: Achieve announced a June 22, 2026 FDA cytisinicline NDA Complete Response Letter citing third-party manufacturing and labeling, with no clinical efficacy or safety deficiencies identified. A regulatory CRL is not a Phase 3 endpoint failure.
